subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Fazer uso da língua inglesa para expor pontos de vista, argumentos e contra-argumentos, considerando o contexto e os recursos linguísticos voltados para a eficácia da comunicação.

components.description_pt: Apresentar ponto de vista ou opinião clara sobre tópico ou texto em texto de opinião
components.description_en: State a clear point of view or opinion on a topic or text in an opinion piece
components.cc_component_description: State a clear point of view or opinion on a topic or text in an opinion piece

components.description_pt: Construir argumentos em inglês para apoiar um ponto de vista declarado
components.description_en: Construct arguments in English to support a stated point of view
components.cc_component_description: Provide logically ordered reasons supported by facts and details to support a point of view

components.description_pt: Abordar contraargumentos reconhecendo e refutando evidências ou raciocínios opostos
components.description_en: Address counterclaims by acknowledging and refuting opposing evidence or reasoning
components.cc_component_description: Address counterclaims by acknowledging and refuting opposing evidence or reasoning

components.description_pt: Usar recursos linguísticos estrategicamente de acordo com contexto e público pretendido
components.description_en: Use language resources strategically according to context and intended audience
components.cc_component_description: Use language resources strategically according to context and intended audience

components.description_pt: Avaliar a clareza e persuasividade de argumentos apresentados em inglês
components.description_en: Evaluate the clarity and persuasiveness of arguments presented in English
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a speaker's point of view for clarity and logical consistency

cc_matches.description: Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons.
Write arguments focused on discipline-specific content.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar información para...
* introducir y definir un tema y/o entidad
* establecer una postura objetiva o neutral
* añadir precisión y detalles para definir, describir, comparar y clasificar temas
* desarrollar la coherencia y la cohesión en todo el texto
* resumir ideas principales con detalles en mensajes multimodales
* usar recursos del lenguaje estratégicamente según el contexto y la audiencia
Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons and information
Evaluate a speaker's point of view, reasoning, and use of evidence and rhetoric, identifying any fallacious reasoning or exaggerated or distorted evidence.
